related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment session revalidation, exact worktree claim acquisition, and authority-scope regressions
observation.failure_condition: When a base-intent checkout had been selected from a live same-session claim, a later claim acquisition could automatically revalidate after the branch or HEAD advanced. With no live claim yet, revalidation removed the checkout selection before the new claim could be acquired.

implementation.behavior: Environment retains a prior base-intent checkout as observed-base-intent-checkout only when its registered checkout, checkout identity, and Git common-directory identity still match. It refreshes branch and HEAD from the live checkout, reports the row as observed, and leaves claim eligibility unchanged.
implementation.conflict_boundary: The retained observation does not adopt another session's claim. A new claim still passes the ordinary live-claim, rights, and operation-specific checks.

live_campaign_claim.interpretation_limit: One successful exact worktree claim demonstrates this campaign's path; it does not establish that claim friction is generally eliminated.

observation.interpretation_limit: The regression suite verifies one claim lifecycle and preserves the conflict boundary. It does not measure longitudinal agent intervention, cross-session recurrence, changes in tool-call overhead, or the downstream effect on unrelated protected operations.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A valid base-intent checkout can disappear between claim release and safe reacquisition
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment checkout composition and worktree claim acquisition
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The prior composition path required a live same-session claim to retain a base-intent checkout. The claim refresh path can itself trigger revalidation after branch or HEAD drift, before the next claim exists. A bounded regression now verifies that stable read context can survive this gap without becoming mutation eligibility.
not_measured: agent time or tool calls avoided over subsequent work
whether other Environment consumers rely on selection removal after claim release

improvement_relation.basis: The tests exercise no-live-claim revalidation, stable checkout identity, HEAD refresh, successful exact-claim reacquisition, and rejection of a foreign overlapping claim. The same session also acquired a scoped claim on the active campaign worktree through the existing CLI.
not_measured: agent intervention or total tool-call reduction
long-term outcomes after future sessions use the updated mechanism
whether this improvement reduces environmental intervention in later real sessions
whether agents discover and rely on read-context source markers without additional guidance
whether the issue recurs in other base-intent repositories or checkout layouts
